data.body: Change 3532 patch set 1 (5d66f7a6f04): LLM-Review +1, Verified -1. Cause: test_the_header_is_scoped_to_gerrit_by_git_itself ran git config --get-urlmatch with cwd inside the CI checkout, where actions/checkout persists its own http.https://github.com/.extraheader, so the github.com lookup found the runner's header (rc 0, not 1). Test-isolation defect, not a product defect; the test printed no header value (failure line is only assert 0 == 1). Reproduced locally in a repo carrying a github.com extraheader (old test fails, fixed test passes). Fix: lookup runs outside any repo with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES. Also addressed the LLM-Review advisory: test_clone_change_ref_timeout_does_not_leak_the_bot_token now injects a credential into the timed-out argv so the redaction path is still exercised. make verify on da065134e87 exit 0 (21848 passed / 34 skipped, 231 passed / 2 skipped). Pushed as patch set 2. Box baseline 23:12-23:24 PST on bot-deployed-sha c924c0ea2e8 (pre-fix), read-only SSM ps sampler printing counts only: 3096 samples, review-bot Gerrit fetch seen 13 times, URL userinfo in 13 of 13 - the check detects the leak.
